notes:
Video Studio now casts the solo singer once for the picture and the sung soundtrack. New performances get their own vocal blend. To bring back an unnamed singer, choose **Use this performer** on their saved clip and describe the next music video. The selection clears after submission. The original clip supplies the visual reference, which can also carry over its framing and wardrobe.

The singing model runs locally. Managed offline setup obtains and verifies approximately 2.54 GB of additional assets once. The update preserves existing clips and projects.

Verified the native music video tests, performance and screenplay regressions, the offline model manifest, and real GPU conversions of both a fresh cast and a previously approved vocalist.

Short solo clips now record a longer take so they can open on a sung passage. Workbench can record one replacement take automatically when the first one cannot supply the correct vocal. A photo-conditioned music video on a high-memory PC can now use the memory needed to load its picture models, while retaining the existing CPU, process count and physical RAM limits.

Source commit [29ffda0](https://github.com/CaleMediaDev/cale-ai-workbench/commit/29ffda0a18f47a7a6478029425f9e7e7561a6d86).
